verdict.rationale: Docs clearly claim autonomous, unattended multi-hour research jobs (up to ~8 hours) that deliver a completed report/slides, matching the core of the story, but there is no explicit mention of a notification mechanism (email/alert) when results are ready, and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing copy. missing for 10: explicit notification/alerting feature confirmation, independent verification of unattended completion behavior.
